'''Captain Black''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] who served in [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was killed by the [[Esh-kha]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] whilst trying to retrieve a key to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault.<ref name="TOR" />
